transcript.en: Hello, Sandy.
How have you been getting on with your dissertation?
transcript.zh: 你的论文写的怎么样了。

transcript.en: Fine, and I've been working hard on the various action points we agreed on our last tutorial.
transcript.zh: 很好。我努力地按照上次辅导达成一致的各个方面去做。

transcript.en: Do you want to talk me through what you've done?
transcript.zh: 你想跟我说说你都做了什么吗？

transcript.en: Yeah, sure.
Well, we agreed on three main targets for me to aim for.
transcript.zh: 我们达成了三点主要目标。

transcript.en: The first one was to find out about suitable data analysis software.
transcript.zh: 第一点是找到合适的数据分析软件。

transcript.en: Yes.
And what I decided to do was to look through catalogues specializing in IT.
transcript.zh: 我决定浏览一下IT专业上的资料。

transcript.en: That's a good idea.
What did you come up with?
I found the names of two promising ones.
transcript.zh: 我发现了两个不错的软件名。

transcript.en: Right.
But I also thought it'd be worthwhile talking to a lecturer.
transcript.zh: 但我也觉得和老师谈一下是非常值得的。

transcript.en: Oh right.
Who did you see?
Jane Prince.
Do you know her?
She's in the Computer Centre.
Yes, of course, she's the new Head.
transcript.zh: 当然知道，她是新上任的领导。

transcript.en: Yes.
Well, she was very helpful.
Oh, that's good.
Did she suggest anything in particular?
Yeah. She recommended software called 'Vivat' and said I should book up for a couple of practice sessions using 'Vivat'.
transcript.zh: 是的，她推荐了一个叫威瓦的软件，并且说我应该在一些练习课上预定使用它。

transcript.en: Great.
I'm sure you'll find them useful.
transcript.zh: 我肯定你会觉得它们很有用

transcript.en: And, of course, the second target was to draw up a survey checklist which I ...
transcript.zh: 第二个目标当然是草拟调查清单……

transcript.en: Yes, you emailed me it last week.
transcript.zh: 是的，你上周发过邮件给我。是的，你上周发过邮件给我。

transcript.en: Have you had a chance to look…?
Of course, um I think it's good.
Very much on the right lines.
I'd say your first two sections are spot on.
transcript.zh: 我觉得你的前两个部分非常切题。

transcript.en: I wouldn't suggest that you change anything there, but in section three you really do need to have questions on teaching experience.
transcript.zh: 我不建议你再改了，但是你在第三部分真的需要有教学经验的问题。

transcript.en: Yeah. I was thinking that section looked a bit short.
transcript.zh: 是的，我觉得那部分看起来有点少。是的。

transcript.en: Right.
And my third target was, do further reading on discipline.
transcript.zh: 我第三个目标是在专业方面做进一步阅读。

transcript.en: Oh yes. I mentioned a couple of writers, didn't I?
transcript.zh: 是的。我提过几个作家，对吧？

transcript.en: Yes, well I got hold of the Banerjee and I thought that was excellent.
transcript.zh: 是的，我有班纳吉的书，我觉得写得很棒。

transcript.en: But I'm afraid I didn't manage to get hold of the essays about classroom management - you know, the ones by Simon Ericsson.
transcript.zh: 但是我恐怕不能找到西蒙·埃里克森写的关于课堂管理的文章。

transcript.en: The bookshop said it was out of print and the library doesn't have a copy.
transcript.zh: 书店说它已经绝版了，图书馆又没有副本。

transcript.en: Oh right, and I'm afraid I've lent my copy to another student.
transcript.zh: 是的，恐怕我把我的那个副本借给别的学生了。

transcript.en: What I suggest you do is try the library again - this time apply for it through the service called special loans.
transcript.zh: 我建议你再去图书馆试试。这次通过特殊借用的服务方式申请。

transcript.en: Have you done that before?
You're entitled to six books a year.
Yes.
No problem.
That's what I'll do.
So, lots of useful work done.
transcript.zh: 所以已经完成了很多有用的工作了

transcript.en: So, let's look at some new targets.
We'll start by having a chat about your Chapter One.
transcript.zh: 我们从你写的第一章说起。

transcript.en: I very much enjoyed reading it.
Your written style is very clear and you've included lots of interesting descriptions of education in your target area.
transcript.zh: 你的写作风格很清晰，而且你描述了很多教育方面有趣的事。

transcript.en: I've just got a couple of suggestions for some additional work.
transcript.zh: 我只是对一些额外的工作有几点建议。

transcript.en: Of course.
Could I just ask - what do you think I should call it?
transcript.zh: 好的。我能问一下，你觉得我应该怎么命名它吗？

transcript.en: Well, I'd go for something like Context Review.
transcript.zh: 我觉得叫背景回顾怎么样？

transcript.en: What do you think?
Well, short and to the point.
Exactly.
Now, as regards specific areas to work on, I'd be quite interested to have a few more statistics about the schools in the different zones.
transcript.zh: 现在至于一些特殊的地方，我希望有更多关于学校不同方面的数据。

transcript.en: Oh, that wouldn't be a problem.
I can get them from the Internet.
Great.
and although you did make a reference to quite a few different writers, I think you should aim to cite more works written later than 2000.
transcript.zh: 尽管你参考了不少作家的文章，但是我认为你应该更多的引用2000年以后写的文章。

transcript.en: OK.
That's more difficult, but I can try.
transcript.zh: 这有点难，但是我会尽力的

transcript.en: When do you want that done by?
transcript.zh: 你希望什么时候完成呢？

transcript.en: Oh, it's not urgent.
Um I should aim for the end of term.
But in the meantime, I think you should also be thinking about Chapter Two.
transcript.zh: 但是同时，我认为你还应该考虑一下第二章。

transcript.en: Should I be drafting it already?
No, but I think you should note down its main sections.
transcript.zh: 不用，但是我想你应该记下它的主要部分。

transcript.en: Yes.
You know, I always find that the hardest part...
transcript.zh: 我总觉得那是最难的部分。

transcript.en: I always find it helpful to put some ideas on index cards.
transcript.zh: 把一些想法写在索引卡上总是很有帮助。

transcript.en: Yeah.
Um... and then you can sort them, and even lay them out on the floor.
transcript.zh: 你可以将它们分类，甚至码放在地板上。真的很有帮助。

transcript.en: It's a real help.
Well, I'll certainly try it!
When would the deadline be for that?
transcript.zh: 这个截止日期是什么时候？

transcript.en: My advice would be to get it done before you embark upon the research.
transcript.zh: 我的建议是在你着手研究之前完成。

transcript.en: You can always change it later if you need to.
transcript.zh: 如果你需要的话可以在之后随时修改。

transcript.en: Ok. I'll get going on that then.
